And the second one makes from me one verse and you will have verse 2 and according to this the Nun of my face is in the handful that is there SP and also remember it is one verse and six days is verse 2 and PZ 16 the Kf of a box of everything it is tight you shall not kill nor commit adultery nor steal nor shall you answer everything verse 1 and PZ 16 all of them are loose and the zadzi of murder is at the door and the thousand of adultery is in a handful according to what is there I will land. And the purpose of B. Neginot is that the first is arranged per the scripture that every speech and speech is written in the parasha in Pe Shamanchi until you don't carry is one obscure parasha and one speech for this is made one verse from it and also a reminder until you don't kill but full you kill until you don't covet is written in D. hidden parashiyos and they are four conversations for that we make four verses from them and the second It is arranged per the fact that in the matter of reciting there is no full "You will kill until you do not covet" but only one verse, that is, it is forbidden to stop reading it completely in the middle of this verse even when reading it in the singular (Sha'a to say that Tibet shall not kill is a verse in the Gemara that we do not have in the entire Torah a verse less than two verses) and thus when they are read at one time they are recited in the music that connects them, that is, with the lower taste, and also from Anchi until you do not bear and remember until you do not kill, they are stopped for several verses That is why they are called in the lower taste, which is also a melody that interrupts them there. This is the content of the two melodies, and on Sabbaths it is customary to do them in the first, that is, to make one verse of each speech according to which the ten commandments were given in the day. And in Parashat Jethro and Parashat Vatchanan Korin is also recited in Zabur in the lower sense and there are those who use it to happen in Zabur to the world in the upper sense, that is, even in Parshat Jethro and Parashat Vatchanan only the one who calls to himself calls to another. It was written in the Shulchan Aruch by Mahari Luria that one should immerse himself on the eve of Shavuot, and know that anyone who does not sleep at all during the night and is engaged in the Torah is guaranteed that he will complete his sleep and no harm will come to him, so far, and the reason Magen Avraham wrote in his simplest terms is that Israel used to sleep all night and the Almighty needed to wake them up for this reason. eshel-avraham/1:_: And they take out [the Torah scroll]. In several places they are accustomed to pray on Sunday of Shavuot in synagogue like the Tosafot [custom]. At least they should be careful not to take out a Torah scroll, for then the congregation may not afterwards take out [another] — see the reason in such a case siman 144; and in Mishpetei Shmuel siman 3.
kaf-hachayyim/1:_: a) [Section 1] on the fiftieth day of the counting of the Omer, etc., it is late to start Arabic at the beginning of Shavuot so that the counting days are complete. 16 Reish H. 11 O' A, and so on a bit from the latter. It is true that the 15th page of Ket 12b wrote the Daz to be careful only in Kiddush, but what one prays from Be'ai is nothing, Daha Rabbi Ushaia Tsili of Mosh on Shabbat AJG Dedayn, a completed Shabbat is Yeosh. And so whoever prays to him after the MM prayer will not sanctify until the night as Mosh in O' Ahzaz.
kaf-hachayyim/2:_: b) On the first night of Shavuot, from the beginning of the night to the very night, if it is consecrated before the night, it will be missing from the 19th day AD and it is written that there will be seven innocent Sabbaths. AR O. C. Hak Yosef O. A. Shog O. A. Razor O. B.
kaf-hachayyim/3:_: c) Name. On the fiftieth day after the counting of the Omer, etc. and the Rabbis S. Cho wrote that the Shavuot holiday was not hung on the day of giving the Torah, but on the fiftieth day of the Omer, and it is not necessary that it be on the day on which the Torah was given, neither less nor more, but now, according to our calculations, when Nisan is full and Iyar is lacking, it will come to the world that fifty vessels in Shasha in Zion, and to this we remind in prayer the time of the 20th of Yosh. Farah. HI O. A. Hak Yosef O. III. Raz O. A.
